subject: Post-call: Renewal + expansion pricing options (step-ups, blended rates)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acme-health.com>, Raj Patel <raj.p@acme-health.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Renewal + expansion pricing options (step-ups, blended rates)

Hi Sophie / Raj —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + next steps so we’re aligned as you evaluate the renewal and the proposed expansion to add the Summarization and Reranking routes:  

Call recap:
- Current committed usage: ~1M tokens / month (production).
- Intended expansion: add Summarization route (higher avg token per call) and Reranking route for search relevance — estimated incremental volume 4–10M tokens/month in Q4, scaling to 25–40M by next year depending on adoption.
- Primary constraints: target blended unit economics and quarterly budget cap. You mentioned a target blended $/1M tokens in the $800–1,000 range moving forward.

What I’m sending you today:
- Attached: Acme pricing sheet (base tier + step-ups + blended examples).
- Attached: draft amendment with the renewal term + expansion clause for legal to review.

Initial asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the assumed model mix for the expansion (approx % Summarization vs Reranking vs existing generation)? I used a working assumption of 50% summarization, 30% reranking, 20% generation for the blended examples.
2) Confirm budget range per quarter so I can run exact blended invoice scenarios (you referenced ~$250k / quarter as a high-level target).
3) If that aligns, I’ll send 2 pricing options: (A) tiered step-up list pricing and (B) blended committed volume with a predictable blended $/1M tokens.

For transparency on unit economics: our published baseline for the models we discussed today is ~ $1,200 / 1M tokens for small gen routes, and higher for Summarization when in heavy-context mode; however, with committed volume step-ups and blended routing we can reach effective blended pricing near your $800–1,000 target. I’ll show the math in the follow-up.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the confirmed model mix and budget target and put together the 2 formal options by EOD Monday.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: 2026-07-10-Acme-pricing-sheet.pdf, draft-amendment-redlines.pdf
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.p@acme-health.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Renewal + expansion pricing options (step-ups, blended rates)

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:  

1) Model mix: we expect the expansion to look like ~55% Summarization (high token per call), 25% Reranking, 20% current generation traffic for the first 6 months while we ramp usage. If the Summarization trials go well, that could push to 65% by Q1 next year.
2) Budget: procurement gave me a soft target of $240k–$270k / quarter for the initial renewal term. We can stretch for a proven ROI but would need predictable blended pricing to sign.
3) For Summarization we need clarity on latency SLAs and whether hot routes increase unit cost materially — that’s a key negotiation point for the product team.

If you can send a blended example showing our expected mix and a tiered step-up table, that will help procurement and finance approve. Also please include any minimum commitment terms tied to the blended pricing.

Appreciate it,
Sophie
Director of Product 
Acme Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acme-health.com>, Raj Patel <raj.p@acme-health.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Renewal + expansion pricing options (step-ups, blended rates)

Thanks Sophie — great, that mix is very helpful. See attached an updated pricing workbook and a short worked example below based on your 55/25/20 split and a starting commit that scales over 12 months.

Option A — Tiered step-ups (list pricing per 1M tokens):
- 0–5M / month: $1,200 / 1M tokens
- 5–20M / month: $950 / 1M tokens
- 20–100M / month: $700 / 1M tokens

Option B — Committed blended rate (example for Acme starting volumes):
Assumptions (month 1): 5M total tokens / mo with mix = 55% Summarization (higher cost), 25% Reranking, 20% generation.
- Weighted list cost (no discount) computes to $1,040 / 1M tokens.
- Proposed committed blended price: $880 / 1M tokens (15% off blended list) if Acme commits to a 12-month blended volume schedule that reaches >=20M/mo by month 12.

Illustrative math for Q1 (avg 5M/mo):
- List cost = 5 * $1,040 = $5,200 / month
- Committed blended = 5 * $880 = $4,400 / month => savings ~$800/mo (~15%).

Notes on adding routes/models:
- Adding Summarization as a hot route does increase list cost because of longer context windows; our blended pricing accounts for that via the weighted list cost before discounting.
- We can offer a short-term pilot credit to offset initial Summarization tuning costs (we suggested $10k credit during PoC).

Attachments: 2026-07-12-Acme-blended-example.xlsx (blended calc), updated-pricing-sheet.pdf (same items as earlier with the committed blended row added).

Next steps I propose:
1) If $880 blended looks workable against the $240–270k/quarter target, I’ll prepare a formal amendment with the committed blended schedule (targets, ramp milestones, and rollback/fallback routing).
2) I’ll need approval from finance/sales leadership for the 15% blended discount and for any one-time pilot credits. Rishi / Neha — looping you in to approve.

Sophie / Raj — can you confirm by end of day Wednesday if $880 blended is within the procurement budget? If yes I’ll route the amendment for signatures.

Best,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Acme Health - pricing (approval request)

Rishi / Neha — forwarding the Acme exchange. Summary: they target $240–270k/quarter and want a committed blended $/1M around $880 based on the mix they provided (55% Summarization, 25% Reranking, 20% Generation). I modeled a 15% blended discount off weighted list to get to $880, with a requirement that they ramp to >=20M/mo by month 12. Also suggested a $10k one-time pilot credit.

Ask: please confirm approval for (A) 15% blended discount on the example amendment, (B) one-time $10k pilot credit, and (C) priority routing for the Summarization route during the pilot (we should reserve capacity in our Dedicated pool if they sign for the ramp).

If you approve I’ll send the formal amendment + DocuSign link to Acme and loop legal for the redlines.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Acme Health - pricing (approval request)

Marissa — approved.

Response and conditions:
1) Approve the 15% blended discount to get to $880 / 1M tokens for the committed blended schedule tied to ramp milestones (must include clear monthly targets and an automated rollback to tiered pricing if ramp is not met).
2) One-time $10k pilot credit approved. Finance wants the credit to be invoice-applied after pilot close with a clear success gate.
3) Capacity: Marcus will reserve buffer capacity in Dedicated for the initial pilot months; Neha will own the onboarding SLOs and run a health check at 30/60/90 days.

Marissa — please prepare the amendment with the ramp milestones and rollback language. Once legal signs off, send via DocuSign and cc finance (finance@redwood.ai).

Rishi
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
